svg.title: a series that revisits both levels: 0.80 of pairings agree, against a floor of 0.85
svg.desc: Pairwise comparisons of earlier columns with later rows. Plus means later is greater; minus means later is less; equal signs and half-filled cells mean ties. The agreement share, counting ties as half, is 0.8.
